scope: Each documented node: source inspection and mapped tests; fixture success is not deployed/provider/client acceptance.
ui: Overview has eleven summary stages; Full workflow renders all 35 nodes and 46 connections with saved statuses and execution modes. Layout editing does not change execution rules.
findings_fixed: Approval status cannot combine drafts, qualification and safe verification from unrelated prospects.
Manual reply/closed status is not evidence of prior sequence approval; use recorded approval timestamp.
Terminal research/audit job failures remain visible even with preserved reviewable partial evidence.
Fresh-safe count excludes suppression and stale profile/other-domain ownership.
Stale inbox catch-up does not show running monitoring; worker must also be enabled.
Terminal recorded sales journey with no open tasks is complete instead of permanent needs-review.
Unqueued new research is ready; partially qualified aggregate is not complete; latest jobs ordered deterministically.

nodes.label: US/UK search queries or sourced CSV
nodes.behavior_checked: Queries include US/UK context; CSV imports sourced website records. Profile-only records use discovery/profile form, not website-only CSV import.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Search/import live locally; discovery country is an unconfirmed hint.

nodes.label: SearXNG or optional SerpApi
nodes.behavior_checked: SearXNG JSON and optional SerpApi adapter; failed engines are retained as limitations.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Native SearXNG used live; engine blocks/CAPTCHAs observed. Optional paid SerpApi not live validated.

nodes.label: Official company website · domain deduplication
nodes.behavior_checked: Domains deduplicate; profile links/name/reciprocal links produce candidate matches, not verified owners.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: A matched official website was researched; identity and buyer fit still need review.

nodes.label: Business profile · no known website
nodes.behavior_checked: Specific business profile retained with empty website and internal identity key; no fake company domain.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Live LinkedIn record routed to an existing website; actual website-less acquisition not yet accepted.

nodes.label: Public snapshot and named-company website search
nodes.behavior_checked: Robots-permitted profile capture and named-company lookup; matched website creates/reuses a deep-research record.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Live lookup matched IMAGE Skincare UK; LinkedIn capture robots-denied. No private-platform scraping.

nodes.label: Review profile identity, activity and search limits
nodes.behavior_checked: Exact current activity/country quotes, ownership notes and search-limit acknowledgment required. Not-found does not mean confirmed absent.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Verified with fictional captured profiles; real profile identity acceptance pending.

nodes.label: Published profile email candidate · no automatic probe
nodes.behavior_checked: Captured published emails stay candidates; import/probe blocked until profile qualification and inbox ownership review. Candidates can be captured before CR; the later gates still apply.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: No real profile email acquired/probed in current live record.

nodes.label: Robots + sitemaps + HTTP + Chromium
nodes.behavior_checked: Robots, sitemap/depth/page budgets, mediated HTTP and sandboxed JS rendering; report partial or failed coverage.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Real 30-page Chromium research completed with partial coverage; broader 50-domain audit contains partial/failing sites.

nodes.label: Saved evidence · recent public signals · sourced contacts
nodes.behavior_checked: Persist URL, text, hashes and contact identity; only current captures support new ideas. Explicit public signals propose relevant services without an AI key; optional AI can suggest more. Weak/negative cues stay needs-review; every exact quote and interpretation requires review.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Current real website pages yielded matching store/support proposals in a read-only preview; actual pain points, buyer relevance and recent announcements require interpretation/review.

nodes.label: Company-domain contacts
nodes.behavior_checked: Published same-domain addresses are imported and verification queued; buyer role and eligibility remain separate.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Two published website contacts captured; neither established fresh safe.

nodes.label: Other-domain published candidates
nodes.behavior_checked: Other-domain addresses are held with current source URL/hash; no automatic provider probe.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: One live website candidate retained; no automatic import.

nodes.label: Review current official source and company ownership
nodes.behavior_checked: Ownership notes plus current official extraction required; re-crawl/source changes invalidate proof; cross-company inbox attachment rejected.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Fictional reviewed contacts tested; current real candidate remains held.

nodes.label: Reacher verification
nodes.behavior_checked: Strict response/address checks; unknown/risky/catch-all/disposable/invalid cannot pass. Current source, recipient and suppression checked before dispatch and before committing a result.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Native backend/API/auth passed. The earlier isolated recipient was catch-all/risky; a new officially published florist contact received a real safe/non-catch-all verdict. One verdict does not establish universal existence, broader accuracy or inbox delivery; no outreach sent.

nodes.label: Review saved country quote, buyer and one opportunity
nodes.behavior_checked: AI preparation validates current source quotes, US/UK country/timezone and one offer; manual editing remains available. Unsupported inputs stay held; buyer/recipient judgment and final messages still require operator review.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Actual current businesses not qualified by this audit; quote validity alone does not establish semantic truth.

nodes.label: Desktop/mobile screenshots · optional PageSpeed lab audit
nodes.behavior_checked: Desktop/mobile screenshots and optional on-demand PageSpeed; no profile-only site audits and no invented scores.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Real screenshots exist. Keyless PageSpeed live requests returned HTTP 429; no successful live lab score established.

nodes.label: Hold · inspect or research further
nodes.behavior_checked: Hold is represented by lead/profile/contact/message states, not a single unified queue. Uncertain sends require reconciliation; blocked sources and unsafe verification cannot send.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Current verification/profile failures visible; human resolution or provider availability required.

nodes.label: Campaign A · website or inquiry/booking chatbot
nodes.behavior_checked: Campaign A proposes build/improvement/chatbot from public inquiry/service/support cues; one final offer is reviewed. Profile-only improvement excluded.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Fixed cue ranking is not a prediction of client value, sales likelihood or conversion uplift.

nodes.label: Campaign B · ecommerce or suitable WhatsApp workflow
nodes.behavior_checked: Campaign B proposes launch/improvement/chatbot/WhatsApp from source cues; channel-fit, permission/integration and one relevant offer still require review.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: No live WhatsApp sending or client store integration is performed by this acquisition software.

nodes.label: Source-backed personalized draft + 3 follow-ups
nodes.mode: AI preparation and writing; final message review
nodes.behavior_checked: One editable initial email by default, one relevant offer, source references and a current local proof preview. Follow-ups require explicit opt-in; activated content cannot be overwritten.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Historical templates are offline samples only. The current AI writer requires its own configured endpoint and model-quality acceptance; no live AI/provider or recipient acceptance claimed.

nodes.label: Review all messages and outreach eligibility
nodes.behavior_checked: Review the initial email (and all explicitly enabled legacy follow-ups), sender identity, qualification, fresh safe proof, relevance/eligibility notes, opt-out and company conversation gate.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: No real sequence approved. Current source findings and eligibility require operator judgment.

nodes.label: Approve · local send window · mailbox quota
nodes.behavior_checked: Atomic approval; one conversation/company; local weekday/hour window, daily quota and minimum send gap.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Simulated calendars and isolated transport verified; deployed timezone/quota acceptance pending.

nodes.label: SMTP send · durable Message-ID
nodes.behavior_checked: TLS authenticated SMTP, durable IDs/threading, explicit acceptance versus uncertain outcome and no automatic uncertain retry.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Real socket protocols passed on loopback fixtures; external mailbox delivery/inbox placement unverified.

nodes.label: Independent IMAP monitoring
nodes.behavior_checked: Independent mailbox lane, bounded read-only IMAP, UID/identity idempotency and freshness; long crawling does not block it.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Local protocol fixtures verified; no real mailbox credentials configured.

nodes.label: Next due follow-up · stop after touch 4
nodes.behavior_checked: Follow-ups are disabled by default. The opt-in legacy sequence uses gaps 3/5/6 days from actual acceptance with local-window adjustment and stops after touch 4; no overdue burst.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Loopback TLS test used both ordinary and delayed calendars; no real campaign sent.

nodes.label: Stop sequence · human conversation
nodes.behavior_checked: Human reply cancels future touches, creates fulfillment task and shared company hold; manual social replies can be recorded.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Fixture replies verified; the software does not autonomously negotiate with the prospect.

nodes.label: Global suppression
nodes.behavior_checked: Opt-outs/permanent recipient failures suppress globally; unsubscribe GET is read-only and POST performs the stop.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Fixture events/protocol verified; production HTTPS unsubscribe endpoint still requires deployment.

nodes.label: Classify actual reply and fulfill promised value
nodes.behavior_checked: Transport classifies reply/auto-reply/opt-out/DSN. Commercial intent and promised-value fulfillment are operator notes/tasks/stages, not a trained automatic sales classifier.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: No actual external reply fulfillment claimed.

nodes.label: Review audit / concept / FAQ / WhatsApp-flow artifact
nodes.behavior_checked: One automatically prepared source-backed discussion preview for the selected offer; optional annotated screenshot and manual artifacts. Review/export and actual-delivery reference stay separate; no automatic delivery.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Actual Chromium inspected fictional exports. Concepts/FAQ/WhatsApp outlines are prototypes, not deployed client services.

nodes.label: Confirm problem, buyer, budget, timing and success metric
nodes.behavior_checked: Confirmed problem, goal, buyer, timeline, budget and success metric required; a real conversation record gates advancement.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: External buyer confirmation cannot be independently verified by these fixture tests.

nodes.label: Record agreed call and dated next action
nodes.behavior_checked: Record agreed call timestamp and dated next action/tasks. This does not book a calendar or send an invitation.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: No actual booking/calendar integration performed.

nodes.label: Prepare and review scoped proposal
nodes.behavior_checked: Qualified client need, scope, deliverables, exclusions, acceptance, timeline, terms and USD/GBP fee create reviewed downloadable proposal.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Proposal fixtures reviewed; human scope/commercial acceptance required.

nodes.label: Record actual proposal delivery
nodes.behavior_checked: Delivery requires reviewed proposal and explicit actual-delivery reference; not automatic SMTP proposal delivery.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: No real client proposal sent by this audit.

nodes.label: Record agreement and initial payment references
nodes.behavior_checked: Won/delivery/completed require agreement and initial-payment references; no payment processor or signature collection.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: References are operator assertions, not verified receipts or signed documents.

nodes.label: Manage delivery tasks and record client acceptance
nodes.behavior_checked: Delivery tasks and closure outcomes; completed stage requires client acceptance reference. No automatic client website/WhatsApp deployment.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: Actual client delivery and acceptance remain external.

nodes.label: Record measured or inconclusive outcome and campaign learning
nodes.behavior_checked: Outcome notes can be inconclusive. Learning reports frozen campaign/service/country/industry groups, accepted-record-to-human-reply/qualified/recorded-won rates and next-review guidance. No denominator means unknown; repeats and auto-replies cannot inflate conversions. Recorded USD/GBP cost and receipt reports remain separate, with immutable correction history. Completed clients can have dated maintenance/expansion plans and permission-reviewed frozen case studies; external work/publication remains operator-recorded.
nodes.live_or_manual_boundary: No automatic analytics attribution, A/B optimization, verified revenue or evidence of conversion uplift. Historical contexts missing an approval snapshot remain unknown.
